_comment: Class of Service and capacity policy. This file is the deterministic authorization boundary: the LLM supervisor cannot change it, and anything not granted here is denied. A missing file yields the same posture as an empty one - no external dialing anywhere. Routing DATA (extensions, DIDs, ring groups, symbolic targets) lives in each tenant's routing file, not here - this file only says what is PERMITTED, never what a name means. A leftover "symbolic_targets" key here is a hard startup error.
_comment_tenants: Per-tenant Class of Service, keyed by tenant name. Empty means nothing is granted anywhere - the safe posture: a tenant with no entry can take calls and route internally, but reaches no external destination. See docs/TENANT-EXAMPLE.md for a fully populated block.
